yaml:
scenario: CKD_Staging
version: 1.0.0
description: Stage chronic kidney disease based on eGFR using KDIGO G categories
signals:
  eGFR:
    ref: estimated_glomerular_filtration_rate
    expected_unit: mL/min/1.73m2
    description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate
    concept_id: 37208635
    concept_code: '1107411000000104'
    vocabulary_id: SNOMED
trends:
  egfr_current:
    expr: last(eGFR)
    description: Current eGFR value
logic:
  stage_G1:
    when: egfr_current >= 90
    severity: low
    description: 'Stage G1: eGFR >= 90 mL/min/1.73m2'
  stage_G2:
    when: egfr_current >= 60 AND egfr_current < 90
    severity: low
    description: 'Stage G2: eGFR 60 to 89 mL/min/1.73m2'
  stage_G3a:
    when: egfr_current >= 45 AND egfr_current < 60
    severity: medium
    description: 'Stage G3a: eGFR 45 to 59 mL/min/1.73m2'
  stage_G3b:
    when: egfr_current >= 30 AND egfr_current < 45
    severity: medium
    description: 'Stage G3b: eGFR 30 to 44 mL/min/1.73m2'
  stage_G4:
    when: egfr_current >= 15 AND egfr_current < 30
    severity: high
    description: 'Stage G4: eGFR 15 to 29 mL/min/1.73m2'
  stage_G5:
    when: egfr_current < 15
    severity: critical
    description: 'Stage G5: eGFR < 15 mL/min/1.73m2'
  ckd_stage:
    when: stage_G1 OR stage_G2 OR stage_G3a OR stage_G3b OR stage_G4 OR stage_G5
    severity: high
    description: Chronic kidney disease stage determined
outputs:
  decision:
    ckd_stage_detected:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.ckd_stage
      description: Chronic kidney disease stage detected
  features:
    egfr_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.egfr_current
      description: Current eGFR value for staging
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: When this evaluation was performed

details.matched_concept: Estimated glomerular filtration rate by laboratory calculation
